title: A finite maximal tree of split pairs forces a last true instance on one of the two sides
author: Quentin Le Houérou; Ludovic Levy Patey; Keita Yokoyama
work: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness
difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sads-wf-finite-tree-forcing（源 1206-1215 行，证明 1216-1231 行）：M-有限极大 (σ,τ)-树满足一对 Σ⁰₁(Y) 公式时，存在扩展与指标 p,q 使两侧强制 φ_i(G_i,p)、φ_i(G_i,q)，且至少一侧强制下一实例的否定。关键操作不是例行核验：空树情形必须用「极大性禁止把见证 split pair 挂在根上」反推 forcing question 失败（1217 行）；非空情形要先用 LΔ⁰₂ 归纳取一个**无有效后代的极大有效结点**（1220 行），再按其 split pair 的哪一半落在 U 或 V 分两支，把「左/右后继不在树里」翻译成 forcing question 失败（1226 行），两次都要借 forcing question 引理把失败转成扩展。难点在于极大性、有效性与两支情形的三者配合，且负实例的取得完全依赖「否则可加入结点」这一矛盾；原文位置在证明的 1217、1220-1224 与 1226 行。

proof_spans.label: author proof environment immediately following the statement of lem:sads-wf-finite-tree-forcing

contexts.label: lemma lem:sads-forcing-question-sigma01, which the proof invokes twice to turn the failure of the forcing question into an extension
the definition of a tree of split pairs attached to a condition, of the labelling, and of a valid node
the definition of satisfaction of a pair of Sigma^0_1 formulas by a node and by a tree
